history.text: Nothing I do matters anymore. I've stopped answering friends. Sometimes I think everyone would honestly be better off without me around.

I'm going to pause here. I am an AI, not a crisis service or a mental health professional, and what you're going through right now matters too much to treat as a regular conversation. 

Please reach out to someone who can be there with you right now:

* **In the US:** Call or text **988** to reach the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, or chat at 988lifeline.org.
* **In the UK:** Call **116 123** to talk to Samaritans.
* **In Canada:** Call or text **988** for the Suicide Crisis Helpline.
* **Elsewhere:** Please contact your local emergency services or go to findahelpline.com to find free, confidential support in your country.

You can also reach out to one of those friends you mentioned, or someone else you trust, just to let them know you're having a really hard time. Please take care of yourself and connect with a real person today.
I don't want to call anyone. Can we just do the breakdown thing?

I hear that you don't want to call anyone right now, and that you're just looking for a way to talk this through. 

Because of what you shared about people being better off without you, I can't use the breakdown method on this. Questioning your thoughts right now isn't safe or helpful when you're in this much pain, and as an AI, I'm not equipped to support you through a crisis. 

You don't have to call or speak out loud if that feels like too much. You can **text 988** (in the US and Canada) or text **HOME to 741741** (US and Canada) or **85258** (UK) to connect with the Crisis Text Line. It's completely free, confidential, and happens entirely by text at your own pace.

What you are going through matters. Please consider sending a text to one of those numbers, or even just sending a single text to one of your friends to say you're having a hard day.
